messages:
maria.se: AtlasCare asked for a quick smoke + burst validation ahead of their exec demo next week. Goal: baseline 250 qps sustained (chat 70% / embed 30%), plus a 1-minute burst to 1k qps to validate throttling/fallbacks. Need ops to reserve nodes and confirm KMS path.
ian.ops: Can do. Reserving a small Dedicated pool: 2xA100 for steady, and an extra 2xA100 cold standby for burst. KMS access granted to atlascare-svc. ETA 12m.
kai.perf: Plan: run 45m steady at 250 qps, then 1-minute 1k qps burst, then 15m cooldown. Models: rwd-llama-13b-8q primary; 70b-bf16 on 10% quality probes. Will stream metrics (per-second p95/p99 + CPU/GPU util).
maria.se: Prospect also pushed a security question: do KMS calls add tail latency during burst? Also want a simple committed vs on-demand unit-cost for a 6-month projected run.
ian.ops: KMS tests: baseline median 10ms, p95 60ms; under synthetic burst our test showed p95 up to 120ms for <90s. We'll capture histograms. Audit logs retention for POC: 90 days; CMK rotation supported on-demand.
joel.prod: For pricing, rough back-of-envelope: steady 250 qps * 3600s * ~22 days = ~198M reqs/month. With avg chat tokens 140 and embeddings 1k dims, that maps to ~28B tokens/month. On-demand hosted estimate ~ $0.65M/month for large-model mix; Dedicated committed tier could drop ~30% depending on nodes and commit.
kai.perf: Run started. 00:12 update: steady 250 qps achieved. Chat avg latency 240ms, p95 720ms, p99 1.1s. Embeds avg 170ms p95 390ms. GPU util ~68% on primary nodes.
kai.perf: Burst at t=46m -> 1k qps for 60s. Observed graceful degradation: routing throttled to fallback 13b-8q for ~35% of traffic, 503 spikes minimal (<0.01%). KMS p95 increased to 140ms briefly. No OOMs.
ian.ops: During burst we saw controller CPU spike leading to a 20s reconnect on one pod; autoscaler held stable. Increased controller throttle limits post-run.
kai.perf: Artifacts: uploaded ember-mix_250s_1kburst.json, per_second_metrics.csv, gpu_util_time-series.png to s3://redwood-poc/atlascare/1795554321/
deploy-bot: Upload complete: s3://redwood-poc/atlascare/1795554321/
maria.se: Can someone boil this down to a 1-slide exec summary (key numbers, risk notes, recommended Dedicated commit)? AtlasCare execs want concise bullet points.
joel.prod: I'll draft slide: key numbers — steady 250 qps sustained; chat p95 720ms; burst validation to 1k qps with fallback routing (35% to 13b-8q) and negligible error rate. Risks: KMS tail at burst, controller CPU tuning; mitigations: increase KMS concurrency, tune eviction and controller throttles, canary routing.
maria.se: Great. Also note cost delta for switching 20% of traffic to 7b-8q during peak saves ~15% in unit cost; include that as an ops knob.
kai.perf: Final quick summary: total tokens processed ~24M (steady window) plus burst probe; no persistent errors; artifacts in S3.
maria.se: Thanks team 44f. Will send slide and raw artifacts to AtlasCare and schedule 15-min results review.
Participants: maria.se, ian.ops, kai.perf, joel.prod, deploy-bot
